decision.author: albanD
decision.body:
Thanks for a PR, suggesting a different way to fix it!

Also I think this would happen for any call via `torch.ops`. So you don't actually need a custom op, you just need an in-core op that triggers a warning. That should simplify your test significantly

inline_comments.body:
I don't think this is the right fix. As this system is supposed to work in tandem with exeption handling to perform well (see .set_in_exception() and similar things).

I think a better fix here would be guard all of this call into the HANDLE_TH_ERROR macro and END_HANDLE_TH_ERROR_MACRO_PYBIND. That one handles error translation and warning in one go and ensure everything works well.
